description: Nepal's biggest and most important festival: 15 days of goddess worship, family reunions, tika and jamara blessings, feasts, kites, and bamboo swings. Vijaya Dashami (tika day) falls on Wednesday, October 21, 2026. DMV Nepali organizations typically host community Dashain gatherings on the weekend closest to tika day; watch this board for announcements.
location: Celebrated across the DMV Nepali community
title: Dashain 2083 (Bada Dashain)

description: The festival of lights: five days honoring crows, dogs, cows, oxen, and the bond between brothers and sisters. Laxmi Puja on November 8; Bhai Tika on Wednesday, November 11, 2026. Community Deusi-Bhailo programs and Tihar parties will be listed here as organizers announce them.
location: Celebrated across the DMV Nepali community
title: Tihar / Deepawali 2083
